title: Single and Double Underscores in Python Names
description: Learn Python naming conventions with single and double underscores to design APIs, create safe classes, and prevent name clashes.
summary: Python has a few naming conventions that are based on using either a single or double underscore character ( _ ). These conventions allow you to differentiate between public and non-public names in APIs, write subclasses safely, prevent name collisions, and more.
takeaways: In Real Python’s Object-Oriented Python live course, you build a complete simulator with an instructor and practice designing classes that feel native to Python.
